headline: Casualty Rates Shift Across Principal Fronts
war_summary: The latest despatches show a mixed picture across the contested map. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theatre, has seen its two‑hour losses drop to 268 Colonial and 290 Warden from the eight‑hundred‑odd figures reported three hours ago, while its daily base turnover has eased. Linn Mercy has surged, recording 377 Colonial and 699 Warden dead in the last two hours, a sharp rise from the earlier ninety‑three and two‑hundred‑forty‑three. Nevish Line remains fierce, though its two‑hour toll has fallen to 654 Colonial and 891 Warden. Mooring County holds steady with 69 Colonial and 32 Warden casualties. Stonecradle reports a shift, Colonial losses down to 56 but Warden losses climbing to 228. Callahans Passage, after a brief spike, now logs 750 Colonial and 590 Warden dead. Dead Lands, previously quiet, now adds 44 Colonial and 75 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow, once dormant, has produced eleven ownership changes in the past two hours with modest losses. Enlistments continue to climb in the active sectors, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder.
